preflash: SWD backup configuration region and compute SHA-256
parse and validate both V3 slots
record original application readback and frozen recovery SHA
diagnostic_flash: erase/program/verify application pages 0-103 only; never erase configuration pages
test: stable target region, bounded INVALID_INPUT with SWD disconnected for the full duration, automatic restore, ABORT restore, candidate and formal-output monitoring
restore: abort injection, erase application pages 0-103, program frozen 0x0515 BIN pages 0-102, verify, reread configuration and compare SHA, final Modbus probe
reset_effect: SWD backup/flash resets MCU and clears all volatile R5 and diagnostic state
